visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed background image or video with overlaid headline, text and CTAs; desktop: text over the media with optional gradient; mobile/tablet: text below the media overlapping it with a fade to black
contentPattern: Row 1 (media): desktop image, mobile image[, tablet image] - or poster images + desktop/mobile video links. Row 2 (content): heading(s) (first = headline, further = subsection), paragraphs, CTAs.
